'''Willim al'Dai''' was a [[Two Rivers]] man who once served on the [[Emond's Field]] [[Village Council]]. He appears in [[The Eye of the World/Ravens|Ravens]], but is only named as '''Master al'Dai''' in that chapter. His full name is given in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]].

==History==
He was [[Bili al'Dai]]'s grandfather and [[Hu al'Dai]]'s father.{{ref/book|1|Ravens}}{{ref|{{Twotc|Willim al'Dai}}|comp}}  This fact ties the Ravens and Companion together suffiently to conclude they refer to the same person.

Willim was once on the Emond’s Field Village Council.{{ref||comp}} 

He died of old age well before the first appearance of Trollocs in the Two Rivers.{{ref||comp}}
